test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 23 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which one of the following multipurpose projects in India is constructed on river Narmada?
solution:
The correct answer is **Sardar Sarovar Project**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Sardar Sarovar Project** is one of the largest dam projects on the river Narmada.
 
• It aims to provide water for irrigation, drinking water supply, and hydroelectric power generation.
 
• The project is located in the state of **Gujarat**.
 
• It is a part of the larger Narmada Valley Development Project, which includes multiple dams and canals.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Korba Project
 Located in Chhattisgarh, primarily a thermal power project.
 
 

 Mettur Project

 Farakka Project
 Located in West Bengal, constructed on the river Ganges, primarily for irrigation and navigation.
